condition_scopes.frozen: all parameters and BN buffers unchanged
condition_scopes.tent_bn: BN affine only; target support entropy; query uses its own batch statistics without gradients, declared transductive-forward control
condition_scopes.tent_entropy_gate: Only four Transformer head LayerNorm affine modules (8 tensors/1024 parameters); BN parameters and buffers, final_norm, classifier frozen; [0.2,0.4] nat entropy gate
condition_scopes.proteus_default: Full wide_bn mechanism port: sourceCE+hard pseudoCE+MMD+entropy/diversity; normal source/target/pseudo BN forwards; Adam lr0.001; GMM2 refresh40steps posterior0.6; stop if selected<128 or degenerate; not official RF reproduction
condition_scopes.no_pseudo_fixed: All parameters except classifier and final_norm affine; normal source/target BN updates; sourceCE+MMD+entropy/diversity; no pseudo or GMM; Adam lr0.00025
condition_scopes.tent_coadapt: All parameters, target support entropy only, no gate; source BN buffers fixed; dropout train during update; Adam lr0.00025; diagnostic control only

permissions.source_labels: source CE for Proteus and no_pseudo only
permissions.query_labels: Terminal metrics and after-the-fact figure diagnostics only; never updates, threshold selection, checkpoint choice or early stopping

diagnostics.probe_role: fixed reference only; all1024; no labels; model.eval; no query statistics or RNG effects
diagnostics.claims: measure actual norms/entropy/NAR; no forced explosion,98% trap or lowest-NAR claim

selection: terminal step800; no query-based selection or hyperparameter sweep
exposure: Temporal dates already observed; external WTT/AWF results also observed before this version; this Temporal experiment is development evidence and creates no new external confirmation
